# 1 Enoch Chapter 83 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Book of Dreams

---

**83:1** And now, my son Methuselah, I will show you all my visions which I have seen, which I recount before you.

**83:2** Two visions I saw before I took a wife, and the one was unlike the other: the first when I was learning to write; the second before I took your mother, when I saw a terrible vision. And regarding them I prayed to the Lord.

**83:3** I had lain down in the house of my grandfather Mahalalel, when I saw in a vision how the heaven collapsed and was borne off and fell to the earth.

**83:4** And when it fell to the earth I saw how the earth was swallowed up in a great abyss, and mountains were suspended on mountains, and hills sank down on hills, and high trees were riven from their stems and hurled down and sunk in the abyss.

**83:5** And thereupon a word fell into my mouth, and I lifted up my voice to cry aloud, and said: "The earth is destroyed."

**83:6** And my grandfather Mahalalel woke me as I lay near him, and said to me: "Why do you cry out so, my son, and why do you make such lamentation?"

**83:7** And I recounted to him the whole vision which I had seen, and he said to me: "A terrible thing have you seen, my son, and of grave moment is your dream-vision, and it concerns the secrets of all the sin of the earth: it must sink into the abyss and be destroyed with a great destruction.

**83:8** Now, my son, arise and make petition to the Lord of glory, since you are a believer, that a remnant may remain on the earth, and that He may not destroy the whole earth.

**83:9** My son, from heaven all this will come upon the earth, and upon the earth there will be great destruction."

**83:10** After that I arose and prayed and implored and besought, and wrote down my prayer for the generations of the world. And I will show you everything, my son Methuselah.

**83:11** For when I went out below and saw the heaven, and the sun rising in the east, and the moon setting in the west, and a few stars, and the whole earth, and everything as He had known it from the beginning, I blessed the Lord of judgment and extolled Him because He had made the sun to go forth from the windows of the east, and to ascend and rise upon the face of heaven, and set out and keep traversing the path shown to him.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus rendering adjudicated from EMET, LOGOS, and PNEUMA. Chapter 83 opens the Book of Dreams. Enoch's first dream-vision is a pre-flood catastrophe (heaven collapsing, earth swallowed — a reversal of creation). Mahalalel (Gen 5:12-17, Enoch's grandfather) interprets the vision and counsels Enoch to intercede for a remnant. Enoch prays and writes the prayer for future generations. The closing scene (v. 11) — ordinary sunrise after apocalyptic vision — is theologically significant: the world still runs according to God's order.*
